answer: Every identity is a timber beam in a shared frame, load-tested rather than paper-tested: each epoch a random set of tasks with verifiable output fingerprints is routed through each account, and a beam that cannot carry its stated load in the measured window is demoted. Termites fail together: sybils sharing one machine share the same timber, probes arrive at once, and a hollow beam cracks under parallel load. Even sable-thin claims earn no marble-grade attestation; weight flows only to beams that prove capacity. A farm buys one real machine per fake, forever - the rent is the wall.
